focus_areas: Existence and structural connectivity of the pointer hand/needle
Topological separation of the central mechanism from the dial background
Distinction between optical blur and generative structural collapse
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the distinction between a poorly photographed real object and an AI-generated object. Real barometers always have crisp, legible numbers and a distinct needle. If the 'blur' obscures the physics of the needle (e.g., no shadow, no pivot point, merging with background), it is likely an AI artifact. Verify if the 'gibberish' in the center follows any typographic structure or is pure noise. Prioritize the verification of the missing pointer hand using open-vocabulary detection and topological segmentation.
image_description: A low-resolution, close-up image of a circular instrument resembling an aneroid barometer. It features a metallic or plastic casing with a white dial face. The center of the dial contains a dark, indistinct graphic or logo rather than clear text or a mechanical pointer. There appear to be faint markings around the perimeter, but they are illegible due to blur and potential generative artifacts. The background is a uniform, light blue-grey color.
